% The exact occurrence i is not a tuple of time and detector. It binds the
% observation; detector occurrence and UID; stable RTC output index n; exact
% PTC product/application generation; segment; array/network/group; and its
% full parent chain. Time and storage positions are associated attributes or
% locators only.  z_i=Z_i^PTC is the transformed signal; gamma_i is the exact
% PTC-selected MAP-facing coefficient, when such a family exists.  x and r
% remain reserved for the paired upstream KID readout coordinates.

% A stable original occurrence u is the ALIGN-owned acquisition occurrence,
% keyed by observation, detector occurrence/UID, native occurrence identity,
% stable ALIGN slot, and exact ALIGN mapping generation.  Its own coordinate
% is the layered AST ALIGN-grid direction/tangent/continuous-pixel role bound
% to the target MAP WCS through SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE
% v0.1/r0.1.  It is never a descendant RTC-output coordinate.  The causal
% influence graph remains a separate support fact and never duplicates
% detector-seconds.
